modmenu.descriptionTranslation.koreanpat: It allows you to input Hangul naturally, and the Hangul input state does not interfere with other keys.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.description: It displays Korean/English input status near the input field.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.general.des: General settings related to the indicator.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.general.sho: It displays Korean/English input status near the input field
koreanpatch.config.color_opacity.ko.desc: Set the color of the %s when the input state is Korean.
koreanpatch.config.color_opacity.en.desc: Set the color of the %s when the input state is English.
koreanpatch.config.color_opacity.ime.des: Set the color of the %s when the input state is IME. (IME state means that the operating system input method is entering directly, such as vanilla Minecraft)
koreanpatch.config.color_opacity.descrip: Set the opacity of the %s color.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.outline.sho: In the Korean/English indicator, the outline is displayed for readability.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.outline.out:
Set the outline type.
- Rectangle: Rectangle corners
- Circle: Circle corners
- Superellipse: Superellipse corners
koreanpatch.config.indicator.text.name: text
koreanpatch.config.indicator.animation.d: These are the settings that the indicator follows the text cursor position.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.animation.s: The indicator allows you to follow the text cursor position.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.animation.e:
Set the Easing function used when the indicator moves.
You can find it more easily by referring to easings.net.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.animation.s: Set the animation speed. The larger the value, the faster you follow the cursor.
koreanpatch.config.input.general.descrip: General settings related to keyboard input.
koreanpatch.config.input.general.auto_la: Specifies the Korean/English/Vanilla Input Method (IME) state whenever a screen with an input field is opened.
koreanpatch.config.input.general.memory_:
When a screen is closed, remembers the Korean/English/Vanilla Input Method (IME) state for that screen. When the screen is reopened, it automatically sets the input language to the state it was in when last closed.

- If there is already remembered data when the screen opens, the 'Auto Input Method Switch' and 'Auto Set Input Language' features are ignored, and the input method switches according to the remembered data.
- Enabling the 'Always Enable OS Input Method' feature does not affect the remembered data.
koreanpatch.config.input.ime.description: Settings related to the operating system input method (Vanilla Minecraft) and this mod's (Korean Patch) input method. (It is recommended not to change these settings)
koreanpatch.config.input.ime.disable_ime: Disable OS Input Method While Playing
Automatically disables the operating system's Input Method while playing to avoid interfering with player movement (WASD).
koreanpatch.config.input.ime.auto_ime_sw: Automatically enables the operating system's Input Method when the mod detects it failed to inject into the current screen successfully, and automatically disables the OS Input Method when it detects successful injection.
koreanpatch.config.input.ime.always_ime_: Allows using the Minecraft Vanilla input method (IME) alongside the Korean Patch input method, similar to typical Korean chat mods, without disabling the patch's input features.
